name: Prism Drift
description: High-end demo: a molten glass blob with RGB dispersion and thin-film iridescence over a synthwave world, with a multi-pass post pipeline (render targets, chromatic aberration, two-level bloom, anamorphic streaks). Built entirely through the PatchToy MCP server. Tweak it in the Parameters panel (P): Glass, Iridescence, Camera, Post and Music.

data.text:
# Prism Drift
A molten glass blob with RGB dispersion and thin-film iridescence over a synthwave world, finished by a multi-pass post pipeline.
Reacts to music: open the audio menu → Mic (the grid pulses on the beat, the sun on the bar).
## Tweak it in the Parameters panel
Press P (or the sliders button in the top bar): Glass, Iridescence, Camera, Post and Music settings with pretty names; hover a name for what it does, double-click a slider to reset it.
Double-click a group box to open it, Esc to come back.

## Scene SDF
Torus ∪ orbiting sphere with a smooth union, plus a little 3D Perlin noise on the surface. GlassRaymarch refracts through this distance field.

## Glass Shading
The environment is sampled three times along slightly different refracted rays (one per RGB channel) for dispersion, tinted by absorption, then a reflection, a cosine-palette thin film driven by Fresnel and a Blinn-Phong specular are layered on top.

## Render Targets
Feedback nodes act as render targets: one stores the graded frame (for chromatic aberration), two store a bright pass (luma smoothstep) that feeds the bloom and streaks.

## Bloom
The bright pass is blurred at two radii and added back, plus a horizontal anamorphic streak tinted blue-violet.

## Post FX
Chromatic aberration on the graded frame, bloom added, then vignette and film grain.

## Music
Audio level gates everything: with the audio off or silent, drive = 0 and the piece looks exactly as before. drive = music × smoothstep(level).
- Beat: a pulse of light rolls down the synthwave grid and lands at the camera on each beat (inside Synth Env, also seen in reflections and refractions).
- Bar: the sun stripes open up and the sun brightens on each downbeat, easing back over the bar.
- Bass: the thin-film glow of the glass breathes (+20%) and the bloom threshold drops (0.85 → 0.76).
Beat-phase couplings (the grid pulse and sun bar inside Synth Env) are also multiplied by the beat tracker's confidence (Beat.confidence = u_beatConfidence: 0 with the audio off, ~1 once the beat locks, 1 with the metronome) and run on the stable beat clock with its certainty gate (x smoothstep(0.25, 0.75, u_beatTrust) in the shader): after a track change the clock holds the old tempo, then glides to the new one without jumps, and these couplings fade out until the new beat is trusted. Level and band couplings (bass film glow and bloom threshold) are not.

data.label: Camera height
data.description: Camera latitude (radians).

data.label: Camera distance
data.description: Distance from the camera to the blob.

data.label: Torus spin
data.description: Rotation speed of the torus.

data.label: Melt
data.description: Smooth-union radius between the torus and the sphere.

data.label: Noise flow
data.description: How fast the surface noise flows.

data.label: Surface noise
data.description: Perlin displacement of the surface.

data.label: Film bands
data.description: How many thin-film bands run up the blob.

data.label: Film glow
data.description: Brightness of the thin-film iridescence.

data.label: Film saturation
data.description: 0 = white reflection, 1 = full thin-film colour.

data.label: Highlight colour
data.description: Colour of the sun specular highlight.

data.label: Highlight intensity
data.description: Strength of the specular highlight.

data.label: Streak tint
data.description: Colour of the anamorphic streak.

data.label: Bloom
data.description: Tight bloom level.

data.label: Bloom wide
data.description: Wide bloom level.

data.label: Streak
data.description: Anamorphic streak strength.

data.label: Field of view
data.description: Camera field of view in degrees.

data.label: Index of refraction
data.description: How strongly the glass bends light (1 = air, 1.5 = glass, 2.4 = diamond).

data.label: Dispersion
data.description: RGB split of the refracted rays.

data.label: Absorption
data.description: Beer-Lambert absorption per channel (R, G, B): higher = that colour is absorbed.

data.label: Music reactivity
data.description: 0 = ignore the music. The grid pulses on the beat, the sun opens on the bar, the glass glows on the bass.
